title: Fare Brands, Route Scope and Itinerary Limits of Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes
content:
Under Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes, the holder and the companion are ticketed together only in the fare brands listed for the product, only on the itinerary classes it covers, and only within the segment and stopover limits below.

## Routing table

| Product | Fare brands in which holder and companion may be ticketed together | Itinerary classes covered | One companion trip covers | Most segments in each direction, connections included | Stopover longer than 24 hours within one trip | Travel to or from Hawaii counts as domestic |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Companion Certificate Main Cabin | Crestline Main Cabin | domestic | a round trip | 3 | not allowed | no |
| Crestline Companion Certificate Main Plus | Crestline Main Cabin, Crestline Main Plus | domestic | a round trip | 3 | not allowed | no |
| Crestline Companion Certificate Premium Economy | Crestline Premium Economy | domestic and short-haul international | a round trip | 3 | not allowed | yes |
| Crestline Companion Certificate First | Crestline First | domestic and short-haul international | a round trip | 3 | not allowed | yes |
| Crestline Companion Pass Semiannual | Crestline Main Cabin, Crestline Main Plus | domestic | a one-way trip | 2 | not allowed | no |
| Crestline Companion Pass Annual | Crestline Main Cabin, Crestline Main Plus, Crestline Premium Economy | domestic and short-haul international | a one-way trip | 2 | not allowed | yes |

## Further terms, identical for every product

| Term | Every product |
|---|---|
| Partner-operated flights may be booked with it | no |
| The holder may travel on an award ticket | no |

## One-way use of a round-trip certificate

| Product | A one-way booking consumes the whole certificate |
|---|---|
| Certificate Main Cabin, Main Plus, Premium Economy, First | yes |
| Pass Semiannual, Pass Annual | no (each pass trip is itself one way) |

## Points of judgement

- "Domestic and short-haul international" covers the domestic itineraries and adds short-haul international itineraries; "domestic" covers domestic itineraries only.
- Travel to or from Hawaii counts as domestic only for the Certificate Premium Economy, the Certificate First and the Pass Annual.
- **Hypothetical case:** a round trip on a Crestline Companion Certificate Main Plus with three segments outbound and two inbound is within the limit of 3 per direction; the same itinerary on a Crestline Companion Pass Semiannual exceeds that pass's limit of 2 per direction.
